title: Course
description: content/<field>/courses/<course-id>/course.json: a course (the folder name is its id) attached to one map node; several courses may share a node, and the order of its lessons (each in <lesson-id>.json next to it). The app joins courses to the map by nodeId; map.json is never edited.

nodeId.description: The map node this course hangs on (an id in map.json).

written.description: When and how the course was made.

sources.description: Where the course's content and numbers come from. Every dataset and course records its source.

tunnels.description: Optional links to other courses in the same field (a tunnel joins two rabbit holes). `needs`: do that course first; add it only for a real prerequisite, one this course uses without re-teaching. `related`: the same idea shows up there. The validator checks that `to` is another course, that none repeats, and that the `needs` links never form a loop. The app shows them as quiet lines on the node sheet and, after the last lesson, offers the course that needs this one; a needed course that is not finished never blocks starting.

to.description: The id of the other course.

why.description: One sentence for the learner: what this course takes from that one, or what they share.

badge.description: A short tag shown in the lesson list, e.g. "Your open task".
